name: ការប្រកាសអាករលើតម្លៃបន្ថែមប្រចាំខែ
legal_reference: Sub-Decree 49 (2024) on the Value Added Tax, article 29(1)(a) (a monthly VAT account), and the General Department of Taxation's home page, read on 2026-10-21, which lists for the period September 2026 a due date of 20 October for a manual return and 25 October for an online one ('Upcoming due date of monthly-annual tax return'). The boxes below are this pack's own short codes for the mechanics the sub-decree confirms — a base and an output tax on taxable sales, a base for zero-rated sales, a base and an input tax on purchases, and the net — and do not claim to reproduce the numbering or the Khmer wording of the form of the e-filing portal, which could not be read.

deadline.legal_reference: General Department of Taxation, home page, read on 2026-10-21: for the period September 2026 it displays the due date '20 October' for a manual return and '25 October' for an online one. This pack declares the 20th, the earlier of the two; a taxpayer filing online has until the 25th by the same page. The provision of the law behind the dates was not read.

boxes.name: តម្លៃលក់ដែលត្រូវបង់អាករលើតម្លៃបន្ថែមអត្រា ១០% (មិនរួមអាករលើតម្លៃបន្ថែម)
boxes.legal_reference: The value, without value added tax, of a sale taxed at the rate of 10 %: Sub-Decree 49 (2024), article 30(2), reads the rate for a sale to a consumer as 10 %, the tax being 1/11 of the tax-inclusive price — see KH-S-STD.

boxes.name: តម្លៃលក់ក្នុងអត្រា ០% (នាំចេញ)
boxes.legal_reference: The value of a sale taxed at 0 %. Sub-Decree 49 (2024), article 29(1)(e), has the taxpayer keep records of sales exported at 0 % with the export declaration and the invoice issued to the foreign buyer — see KH-S-ZR-EXP.

boxes.name: អាករលើតម្លៃបន្ថែមលើធាតុចេញ
boxes.legal_reference: The value added tax charged on box SB, and the tax the recipient of a service from a non-resident supplier accounts for under article 23(3) — see KH-S-STD and KH-P-RC.

boxes.name: តម្លៃទិញដែលមានសិទ្ធិកាត់កងឥណទានអាករលើធាតុចូល (មិនរួមអាករលើតម្លៃបន្ថែម)
boxes.legal_reference: The value, without value added tax, of a purchase whose input tax credit this pack takes as fully deductible: article 11 grants the credit on tax paid on goods and services bought to carry out taxable supplies, article 19 asks for the original tax invoice — see KH-P-STD.

boxes.name: តម្លៃសេវាទិញពីអ្នកមិនមែនជាអ្នកស្នាក់នៅ ដែលអាករត្រូវគណនាដោយអ្នកទទួលសេវា
boxes.legal_reference: The value of a service bought from a non-resident supplier, reported apart from box PB because the tax reaches the return through the recipient's own accounting under article 23(3) and not through a tax invoice of the supplier — see KH-P-RC.

boxes.name: ឥណទានអាករលើធាតុចូល
boxes.legal_reference: The input tax of box PB and the tax self-assessed on box RC. This pack claims the self-assessed credit in the period it is assessed, a simplification named in the README.

boxes.name: អាករលើតម្លៃបន្ថែមត្រូវបង់ ឬឥណទានលើស (យកទៅបន្ត ឬសំណង)
boxes.legal_reference: Output tax less input tax for the period. Article 29(1)(a) has the taxpayer keep a monthly VAT account showing total output tax, total input tax, and the tax payable or the excess credit carried forward or refunded; article 20 lets an excess credit be refunded under conditions the Minister sets. A negative figure is kept as it is: what it becomes (carry forward, refund) is not modelled beyond the figure.
